content_units: Valencia Remote-Work Rental Snapshot

For your priorities,   Patraix   and   Benimaclet   are the strongest fits, with   Patraix   best aligned overall if quiet streets matter most.   Ruzafa   wins on location convenience but is the weakest match for noise sensitivity, while   Extramurs   is excellent functionally but misses your stated budget cap.
Apartment Comparison for Plaça de l'Ajuntament Commute
Option   Area   Rent   Size   Layout   Commute   Remote-Work Fit   Neighborhood Fit

1   Ruzafa     EUR 1,390     78 m2   2 bed, 1 bath   22 min   Good if internet can be installed well; older building may need line check   Convenient and central, but nightlife is a clear downside for quiet living

2   Benimaclet     EUR 1,280     81 m2   2 bed, 1 bath   31 min   Good; extra space plus balcony helps for dual remote work   Mixed student/residential area means livelier than Patraix, but still more balanced than Ruzafa
3   Extramurs     EUR 1,470     74 m2   2 bed, 2 bath   14 min   Very good; renovated unit likely best for modern telecom setup   Excellent commute and comfort, but over budget and slightly smaller

4   Patraix     EUR 1,210     85 m2   2 bed, 1 bath   34 min   Very good; largest space gives better desk separation for a couple   Best match for quiet streets; likely strongest everyday livability value

Remote-Work Decision Notes
Why Patraix comes out ahead
- Safely within budget, leaving more margin for utilities and potential internet upgrade.
-   85 m2   is the most practical layout for two people working from home.
-   34-minute commute   still meets your cap.
- Quiet-area preference is directly matched better than the other options.
Why Benimaclet is the runner-up
- Good price-to-space ratio.
- Balcony is a real quality-of-life plus for long workdays.
- The main trade-off is neighborhood consistency: some streets feel calm, others more student-heavy and active.
Main cautions on the others
-   Ruzafa  : commute and budget fit, but nightlife conflicts with your quiet-street priority.
-   Extramurs  : objectively strong on commute and apartment quality, but it exceeds your budget ceiling.
Move-In and Practical Fit
Context used for this recommendation
- Move-in target is   around 2026-03-01  .
- “Reliable internet possible” is treated as a   building/infrastructure check  , not guaranteed by district alone.
- Nearby grocery access is assumed to be generally good across these Valencia neighborhoods, with   Ruzafa, Benimaclet, Extramurs, and Patraix   all being established residential areas.
What to verify before signing
- Ask for the exact street, not just district, to confirm noise level.
- Request current fiber availability from providers at the precise address.
- Confirm whether one bedroom can comfortably fit a full work desk setup.
- Check elevator/heating/AC status, especially in the   older building   in Ruzafa.
